correctness.rationale: The graph6 encodings are explicit; their complements have face vectors (11,30,20), with 11 circular vertex links and no four-clique. For a flag closed triangulated surface, a diagonal flip remains flag precisely when its opposite vertices have no common neighbors beyond the two endpoints. Exhaustive standard-library checks of all 30 edges in both graphs yield exactly five and four eligible diagonals, all with explicit eleven-vertex graph isomorphism witnesses to the opposite representative. Separate exhaustive permutation backtracking finds exactly ten and eight automorphisms and proves a single allowed-flip orbit in each. The published 2026 exhaustive census plus the join argument establishes exactly two isomorphism classes. Finite enumeration is exhaustive, not inductive extrapolation; the external census is a clearly identified input.

value.rationale: Flag-preserving local moves are the natural connectivity structure on vertex-minimal triangulations. The exact 11-vertex RP2 flip graph is a complete extremal PL-topology classification: all permitted local moves lie in a single automorphism orbit at each end, the two symmetry types have different labeled valences five and four, and every legal move switches type. The elementary common-neighbor criterion provides a reusable obstruction test. The contribution is deliberately finite and does not claim a general manifold theorem; it is more than a renamed f-vector, generic Euler calculation, or isolated edge example.
